title: Construction and simulation of a path-valued model of dendrite development
summary: Neurons receive information through their dendrites. During development, when synaptic connections are forming, dendrites grow, retract, and branch. The resulting dendritic tree shapes the structure of the broader neural network. Crucially, retraction and branching make it necessary to track whole dendritic paths rather than only their endpoints. While this is handled implicitly in some existing simulations, here we construct an explicitly path-valued stochastic process for dendrite growth.
